recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast group portrait of five men in casual dark clothing, positioned against a textured concrete wall with a prominent horizontal graphic header containing a stylized numerical and typographic logo.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure is larger and more forward than the flanking members
A horizontal black bar in the lower third creates a foreground barrier
The top header bar mirrors the lower bar's horizontal weight
Desaturated cyan-grey tones unify the subjects with the industrial background
coreInvariants: Strict horizontal framing elements at top and bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a shallow 'V' formation; the lead singer is centered and scaled approximately 20% larger than the others.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold numerical '3' in the top left header box.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left logo, moves across the header, drops to the central figure, then scans outward to the peripheral band members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample textured space above the subjects' heads and below the horizontal foreground bar.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated cool grey/cyan for skin tones and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for clothing and graphic bars.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the logo text and header highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast; shadows are crushed to black while highlights on the wall are near white.

letterConstructionRules: Square proportions with rounded outer corners
Tight letter spacing within a contained box
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerical '3' is significantly larger and features a double-stroke outline effect
Letters are vertically compressed to fit within horizontal bands

composition.position: top left inside a white box
composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a dedicated graphic header

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and scales for consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the industrial, square-geometric aesthetic of the era.
Similar square proportions but with sharper corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a desaturated, high-contrast photo of five men in dark casual clothes standing against a weathered concrete wall. Add a thick black horizontal bar across the bottom foreground. Leave the top 15% of the image as a flat white and grey gradient header area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top left white box, place a large bold numerical '3' followed by two lines of extended sans-serif text in black, perfectly aligned within the box.

verificationChecks: Is the image desaturated with a cyan/grey tint?
Is the central figure the largest?
Is the text contained within a distinct header bar?
Is there a horizontal bar in the foreground?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible and not distorted
Check that the horizontal bars are perfectly straight
Verify the desaturation doesn't lose all detail in the blacks
Confirm the 'V' formation of the subjects
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Portrait + Horizontal Header/Footer Bars + Extended Geometric Sans Typography + Desaturated High-Contrast Filter
